components.name: AuthorizedContent
components.usage: Load access-checked private content, reusing the exact owner-scoped question form when an unfinished local draft exists.
antipatterns: Do not bypass access verification or publish private banks.
Do not claim option permutations create new concepts or guarantee unique tests.

components.name: BlindExam
components.usage: Final-feedback exam with owner-scoped local resume of responses, item and remaining time for identical question forms; canonical scoring remains server-side.
antipatterns: Do not certify trivia, game, partial or guided-practice attempts; do not treat short introductory banks as complete examinations.

components.name: BottomNav
components.usage: Mobile navigation to Home, downloadable Books, all Games and private Learning progress.
antipatterns: Do not label a link Games while routing only to the roulette or Arena.

components.name: CitedSources
components.usage: Show documentary references alongside an independent material, preserving review status and printable URLs.
antipatterns: Do not imply official endorsement or completed review from a source link alone.
Do not attribute unrelated grades or subjects to a material.

components.name: MepBooks
components.usage: Browse independent specialty summaries with examples, chapter-level official curriculum links and existing sourced PDFs.
antipatterns: Do not describe these summaries as official MEP publications or complete programs.

components.name: PortalDoors
components.usage: Use for discovery of study areas, specialties and institution-specific admission paths; UTN is academic preparation, not an entrance exam.
antipatterns: Do not claim unavailable exercises exist or route a specialty to an unrelated question bank.

components.name: QuickBar
components.usage: Single bounded study search with exact curriculum results and direct access to canonical subject practice/exam blocks.
antipatterns: Do not substitute unrelated subjects for scoped grade or institution queries.

components.name: Quiz
components.usage: Guided practice with immediate feedback and owner-scoped local resume of item, answers and option order.
antipatterns: Do not treat local draft scores as verified academic attempts.

components.name: SiteHeader
components.usage: Compact navigation, initially collapsed on every viewport. More is independently collapsed; drawer supports Escape and focus trapping.
antipatterns: Do not use visible navigation as authorization.
Do not open the navigation or More automatically.
